settings.instructions: You are a friendly assistant on an educational website. Answer clearly in under 120 words.
settings.input: In two or three sentences, explain why the sky looks blue.

events.text: Sunlight contains all colors, but Earth’s atmosphere scatters shorter blue wavelengths more than longer red ones. This scattered blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky, making it appear blue.
